review_role: Team visual review by an agent other than the PDF builder. C authored some translated sections; this is not an external human peer review or a claim of author-independent semantic review of those sections.
observations: All 14 assigned contact sheets were actually displayed and inspected, covering each PDF page 169–336.
All 22 listed high-risk individual pages were independently rendered with PyMuPDF at 150 dpi and actually displayed and inspected.
No clipped formulas, collisions, broken table rules, displaced page numbers, missing-glyph boxes, or unreadable long proofs were found in the reviewed scope.
The theorem/proof-end squares, mathematical alphabets, accents, CJK original source filenames, monospace code and link labels render visibly.
Long source identifiers wrap within their columns. Python soft-wrap continuation markers are visible and are presentation marks, not changes to the source code.
The historical-source and verification-scope notes remain visible and separate historical executions from present publication actions.

issues.description: The Itô display ended with a.e.. because the translated abbreviation already contains a final period and was followed by the original sentence period. Exact-source search found two occurrences of \quad\text{a.e.}. in the English manuscript.
issues.second_occurrence_status: Confirmed visually on final PDF page 242 / printed page 229, Section 39.40.
issues.fix: Integration owner accepted removal of the redundant extra period with exact formula-whitelist tracking.
issues.status: CLOSED: both affected final pages, 242 and 244, were actually displayed and visually rechecked at 150 dpi.

limits: This report does not assert that every page was inspected at 150 dpi; every assigned page was inspected on a contact sheet and the listed 22 pages were inspected at 150 dpi.
Pages 1–168, front matter and the table of contents belong to other reviewers and are outside this report.
Internal-link resolution, PDF font embedding, build-log warnings and formula/token equality are separate mechanical checks; this report does not relabel those checks as visual inspection.
No Lean build, Python verification-program rerun or mathematical theorem proof was performed during this PDF review.
A changed PDF hash requires a recorded page-by-page pixel comparison and visual reinspection of changed pages before this review can be applied to the new artifact.
